**Before submitting a pull request,** please make sure the following is done:

1. If you are part of the Availity organization, clone this repository and create your branch off of `master`. If you are not part of the organization, fork the repository and create your branch off of `master`.
2. Run `yarn` in the repository root.
3. If you've fixed a bug or added code that should be tested, add tests!
4. Ensure the test suite passes (`yarn test`). Tip: `vitest run --reporter=verbose` is helpful in development.
5. Ensure linting passes (`yarn lint`).
6. Make sure your commit messages follow the [Angular Commit Format](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/#summary) — this is enforced by commitlint. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
